q: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

s: people of Israel (God's people) is fed bread of tears (by God)
q: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

s: people of Israel (God's people) is a source of contention to neighbors (Israel's neighbors)
q: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors.

s: people of Israel (God's people) is laughed at by enemies (Israel's enemies)
q: Our enemies laugh among themselves.

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) has roots deep
q: It took deep root, and filled the land.

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) fills the land
q: It took deep root, and filled the land.

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) covers mountains (covered by the vine's shadow) (with its shadow)
q: The mountains were covered with its shadow.

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) has boughs like cedars of God
q: Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) extends to sea (its branches)
q: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) extends to River (its shoots)
q: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) has walls broken down
q: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

s: LORD leads Joseph (like a flock)
q: you who lead Joseph like a flock

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) is plucked by passersby (those who pluck the vine)
q: so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) is ravaged by boar (that ravages the vine)
q: The boar out of the wood ravages it.

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) is fed on by wild animals (that feed on the vine)
q: The wild animals of the field feed on it.

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) is planted by LORD (by his right hand)
q: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

s: vine (Israel as God's vine) is in state burned and cut down
q: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down.

s: Asaph is author of plea for restoration (Psalm 80)
q: A Psalm by Asaph.

s: plea for restoration is addressed to Chief Musician (for musical performance)
q: For the Chief Musician.

s: plea for restoration has tune The Lilies of the Covenant
q: To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.”

s: plea for restoration has refrain Turn us again (cause your face to shine, and we will be saved)
q: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
